name: my-manager
description: My MaNaGeR — offline-first construction PM workspace (Cloudflare Workers static assets).

scripts.verify: npm run verify:csp && npm run verify:sw && npm run verify:hidden && npm run verify:skills && npm run verify:exports
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run predeploy && rm -rf /tmp/mmgr-deploy && mkdir -p /tmp/mmgr-deploy && tar --exclude='.git' --exclude='.wrangler' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='.agents' --exclude='_archive' --exclude='mcp' --exclude='.dev.vars*' --exclude='.gitattributes' --exclude='.gitignore' --exclude='*.md' --exclude='*.json' -cf - . | tar -xf - -C /tmp/mmgr-deploy && cp package.json wrangler.jsonc /tmp/mmgr-deploy/ && cd /tmp/mmgr-deploy && npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npx wrangler deploy
